### Component / Feature Overview
A clear and concise description of what the component or feature should accomplish.

### Use Case
Explain why this addition is beneficial and the primary use cases it addresses.

### Proposed API / Design
Provide preliminary ideas on markup structure, CSS properties, or JavaScript interactions.

### Checklist
- [ ] Accessible keyboard navigation considered
- [ ] Works across light and dark theme tokens
- [ ] Zero external dependencies
